digest.component_or_area: store event append / ticket directory creation
propositions: Directory creation and first event file write are not atomic in the old code; mkdir at line 171 happens outside the write lock, while the first event file lands at os.replace after lock acquisition, creating a window where interruption leaves an empty ticket directory that fsck reports as MISSING_CREATE or FOREIGN_STORE_PATH.
New staging.py module publishes ticket directory and CREATE event atomically via os.rename of a staging directory inside the write lock, eliminating the debris window.
Staging directories use dot-prefixed naming convention (.tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4>) which makes them invisible to existing fsck scanners without scanner changes.
Both single-event stage_and_commit and batch_stage_and_commit paths are converted to use StagedEvent.promote() under the write lock, fixing the identical vulnerability in both.
Concurrent writer interruptions leave only swept stale staging areas owned by dead processes (verified via pid+host+namespace+start-time stamp), never ticket directories or store data.
